current_policy: Batch and cell-line vectors are added before the cell-line dropout mask, so both are removed when c is dropped. This was documented as an unspecified implementation choice.
paper_reference: Section3.1 defines c and b separately; Section3.3 explicitly specifies independent y/c label dropout but does not explicitly state batch-drop treatment. Optional batch conditioning remains a source-level ambiguity.
untested_alternative: Keep batch embedding when the cell-line label alone is null. Need a controlled training/inference study before adopting; no current source/parameter change.
interpretation: Vector norms are descriptive and cannot establish functional importance, an implementation bug, or an explanation of DE/generation errors.
